newsitem.title: USA: PerfectData rejects bid from Polak.
newsitem.headline: PerfectData rejects bid from Polak.

text.p: PefectData Corp on Tuesday said it has rejected a $6.05 per share offer for 40 percent of the company from Polak Investment Group and launched its own $40 million cash and stock bid for Novaquest InfoSystems.

In a statement, PerfectData labeled Polak's bid "as being inadequate." On Friday, Polak raised its bid to $6.05 a share in cash and preferred stock for the 40 percent stake from a previous $5.50 a share for a 42 percent stake.
PerfectData said a merger between it and Novaquest, if completed, "will create a major force in the computer industry, especially in regard to Internet services."

Privately held Novaquest is a re-seller of micro-computer products and services and a developer of an Internet-enabled electronic commerce system. It generated over $172 million in revenue in 1996 and is on track to post sales over $200 million in the current year, PerfectData said.
"This acquisition will fit perfectly with PerfectData's Internet operations and computer peripherals," said Joseph Mazin, chief executive officer at PerfectData.
